# neo's shared PR baseline pin predates the npm overrides job

## Context

neo-agent-skills#89 (merged; 0.1.10 published 2026-09-18) added an `npm overrides` job to the shared `reusable-pr-baseline.yml`. It fails a PR when an npm `overrides` rule no longer holds a floor (REDUNDANT) or forces a dependent below its own range (FIGHTING). `.github/workflows/pr-baseline.yml` pins that workflow at `9ed944a05b`, whose guards install 0.1.7, so the job never runs here.

Dependabot cannot move the pin: it bumps only tag-shaped refs, and neo-agent-skills has no tags (neo-agent-skills#80). It will bump the `neo-agent-skills` npm dependency on its own (a separate PR, since the package is excluded from the grouped update), so that half is not this ticket's.

## The Fix

Move the `uses:` pin to neo-agent-skills `48e3d72a55` (the #89 merge commit). That is the #18466 shape: one line.

What the pin brings besides the new job, 0.1.7 → 0.1.10 guards:
- the archaeology escape binding tightened in neo-agent-skills#84 (0.1.9). The guard judges only files a PR changes, so nothing existing is re-judged, but the next PR touching a file with a loose escape can now go red. #18809 already records the local mirror and the published guard disagreeing, so this is expected, not new;
- an actions-group bump.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `pr-baseline.yml` pins `reusable-pr-baseline.yml@48e3d72a552ef8ce60ef76432d93e4f62257b1d0`.
- [ ] The bump PR's own run shows `baseline / npm overrides` green, reading neo's 3 rules as `needed`.

## Out of Scope

- The npm dependency bump (Dependabot's PR).
- neo-agent-brain, which has no baseline caller at all (neo-agent-skills#40).
